items.prompt:
These customer comments to a bank were grouped together by a clustering algorithm.
Their most distinctive words (c-TF-IDF) are: mortgage, three, rates, payment, adviser.

Comments:
- The mortgage application process took three months, way too long.
- My mortgage adviser explained the fixed and variable rates clearly.
- Why did my mortgage payment increase without notice?
- The mortgage valuation came in lower than the agreed price.
- I want to overpay my mortgage but the app won't let me.
- Your mortgage rates are not competitive anymore.
- First time buyer here, the mortgage team was really patient.
- The mortgage documents asked for the same payslips three times.
- Can I port my mortgage when I move house next year?
- Mortgage offer expired while waiting for your underwriters.
- Thanks for the payment holiday on my mortgage during illness.

Give this group a short topic name of 2 to 4 words. Answer with the name only.

- The mobile app crashes every time I open the payments screen.

- The app is so slow to load my balance in the morning.
- I love the new app design, transfers take two taps now.
- App notifications arrive hours after the payment happened.
- The banking app keeps asking me to update even after I updated.
- Face ID login stopped working in the app this week.
- The app shows the wrong balance until I refresh twice.
- Dark mode in the app makes the numbers hard to read.
- I can't find where to download statements in the new app.
- The app froze while I was paying a bill and charged me twice.
- Please add a widget so I can see my balance without opening the app.
- The app logs me out every few minutes, very annoying.
- Two-factor codes arrive too late to log in.
- My cat knocked a glass off the table this morning.
